searchText: Hey, I'm not up-to-date on the current status of witnesses w.r.t. development (is this tracked somewhere?). My current use case is somewhere between a full node (expensive) and a light node (extra latency for state RPC queries) which seems to fit the witness mechanisms perfectly. Is it possible to use the witness mechanisms today in a private mainnet network (all nodes on mainnet, normal full nodes at the edge to generate witnesses and propagate to inner nodes)? I don't think it is implemented for more than experiment, even though <@!332923501079953409> mentioned something about them using witnesses of some kind in prod yeah, we will have to rework our witness implementation in turbo-geth now that we have changed the architecture
